license.local_policy: Keep LICENSE and NOTICE in the external checkout; do not vendor or redistribute EvE from EconCSLib.

runtime_requirements.uv: Required by upstream; no minimum uv version is declared. Use uv sync --locked against the pinned uv.lock.
runtime_requirements.codex: Default agent backend; upstream declares no minimum Codex version. Its manual hook-trust procedure applies to Codex >=0.130.0.

configuration_contract.application_source: Exactly one of path or github_url plus commit
configuration_contract.editable_boundary: application.editable.files and application.editable.folders; any non-ignored out-of-bound change is rejected before evaluation
configuration_contract.evaluation_steps: Ordered shell .sh paths or judge prompt mappings
configuration_contract.score_schema: Arbitrary YAML PyTree whose numeric leaves include every numeric path present in evaluation.failure_score
configuration_contract.boundary_failure: A failed boundary check skips evaluation and returns application.boundary_failure_score

verified_examples.math_proof_quickstart: configs/eve/math_proof_quickstart.yaml composes application/math_proof_quickstart, evaluation/math_proof, optimizer/math_proof, and loop/math_proof; its solver boundary is the proof folder and its score is a five-dimension PyTree.
verified_examples.minimum_smoke: configs/eve/circle_packing.smoke.yaml overrides the full circle_packing composition with driver/codex_smoke and a two-iteration loop. This sidecar further narrows the public plumbing smoke to one worker and one iteration.

integration.mode: external-checkout plus EconCSLib Hydra config-dir overlay
integration.network_policy: check, dry-run, and fixture evaluation are offline; execute uses uv --offline --frozen --no-sync
integration.no_vendoring_reason: An immutable external checkout preserves upstream history, license/NOTICE, and dependency locking while keeping Python and EvE artifacts outside the Lean/Lake project.
